# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P40](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0040), [v2 c21 P43](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a little lady with thick, wavy snow-white hair carefully arranged in puffs and coils. Beneath her white hair, she has a fresh, girlish, pink-cheeked face with dimples and sweet lips. Her eyes are soft, wood-brown with golden glints.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Lavendar is imaginative and young at heart, often playing games and sharing stories with a dream-child. She maintains a sweet, youthful charm and a gentle voice, though living in isolation sometimes leaves her feeling tired and lonely. Considered peculiar by locals, she retains a deep capacity for romance and affection.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P35](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0035), [v2 c21 P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087), [v2 c21 P88](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0088), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c27 P63](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0063)_

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c27 P63](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0063)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis lived in an old stone house built by her father eighty years prior. Twenty-five years ago, she was engaged to Stephen Irving, but the engagement ended after a quarrel, after which Stephen left for the United States. Following the separation, Miss Lavendar dropped out of local social circles and lived an isolated life in Grafton, where she was served by her handmaiden, Charlotta the Fourth. She spent much of her time indulging her imagination, inventing and playing games with a fictional dream-boy. Anne Shirley and Diana Barry unexpectedly stumbled upon her home while seeking directions to West Grafton and had tea with her. During their visit, Anne accidentally mentioned Stephen Irving's son, Paul, causing Miss Lavendar to inquire about him.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P31](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0031), [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c21 P42](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0042), [v2 c21 P47](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0047), [v2 c21 P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c21 P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084), [v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c27 P63](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0063)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent of lavendar in her mother's home  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Considered a great beauty when she was a girl  <sub>[v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Engaged to Stephen Irving twenty-five years ago before they quarreled and parted  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
